notes: Use this divider to pivot from productivity to sustainability of the growth model. Point out that land expansion is largely exhausted, so the agenda shifts to getting more income per unit of water, energy, and market access. Expect the question: which constraint binds first in Gujarat’s next phase—water, climate volatility, or weak value capture?
title: Gujarat’s next agricultural gains depend more on resilience, resource efficiency, and value capture than on expanding acreage
subtitle: This section examines the state’s next growth frontier after scale and commercialization: protecting output under climate stress, raising returns from each unit of water and irrigation investment, and converting strong production into more durable farmer income through better chain execution.
